articles.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
articles.snippet: SpaceX has raised $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, while Musk predicts a major shakeout among smaller AI cloud providers.

articles.title: Musk warns over 200 AI neoclouds face ‘guppy-level death’
articles.snippet: The warning comes as Gartner forecasts that more than 80% of specialist cloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030.

articles.title: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
articles.snippet: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion chip deal with Apollo while lenders shut the door on smaller AI cloud firms, a split that could decide who controls computing.
